notes.title: Booty Farm Update 9.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]What's New in 9.3:[/b]
Level Cap Increase:

We've increased the level cap from 50 to 60, unlocking more land and all the things that go with it.

[b]Introducing a New Resource - Rice:[/b]

We're adding rice to the mix! Rice patties will be now a normal occurrence in your fertile fields.

[b]More Farm Animals - Goats and Sheep:
[/b]
More furry friends!

[b]Land Expansion:[/b]

More space to cultivate, build, and decorate.

[b]New Building - The Sushi Bar:[/b]

A delicious addition to your farm! The Sushi Bar offers a range of new recipes and products.

[b]11 New Products and Recipes:[/b]

Cook up a storm with new products and recipes that bring all the ladies to the yard.

[b]Fresh Decorations:[/b]

No farm is complete without some fresh decorations.
[b]
Tamiko's Main Story Edit:[/b]
We gave one of the best girls a story facelift, breathing in more love and care in how she acts, speaks, and rocks!

[b]A Special Thanks:[/b]
We want to extend a huge thank you to our amazing community for your patience and constant input on how to improve the game.

[b]What's Next?[/b]
We're working daily on bringing in more exciting stories and hot girls, so stay tuned for more updates. As always, we're eager to hear your thoughts and suggestions, so keep them coming!
Happy farming, and enjoy the new features in Update 9.3!

Warm Greetings,
The Booty Farm Team

---

Note: Please remember to update your game to get the latest new features. If you encounter any issues, send us a support ticket, so we may help out.

notes.title: STELLA: ACAPULCOCK BAY
notes.content:
Pack your bags and pick up your girl - you're taking Stella to the legendary beach resort [b]Acapulcock Bay[/b]! She definitely deserves a break from that overbearing father of hers... A break spent cuddling with you, rolling around on a beach as the waves caress your naked bodies. 🌊

Play the Animated Tapping Event to see [b]a romance with Stella[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646508/8e770fba6e4f342ea8e4b8fdfff886ef3b306a59.jpg[/img]

The Stella Animated Tapping is live May 22nd - June 2nd.

[i]Keep in mind that this is a high difficulty type of event. Not many will complete it until the end, but every time you unlock the next stage, you will receive resources that you can use in the main game![/i]

How to play a Booty Farm Animated Tapping Event:
[list]
[*] click on the event icon in the top right corner
[*] Tap tap tap on the girl!
[*] Raise your Passion level for more powerful taps!
[*] Collect stage rewards every time you complete the meter
[/list]

Earn story beats and photos on lvls 3, 6, 10, and 15.
Save animations to your gallery on lvls 9, 12, and 15.

Truck orders are not affected by the Tapping event, so if you have a purchased DLC, this is a moment for you to complete it in peace. :)

Have fun!

notes.title: Update Bug Fix
notes.content:
[i]EDIT Sept. 26th: The [b]Intrusion [/b] event has been prolonged by 24h to give affected players time to reclaim their lost event progress. Thank you for your patience. [/i]

Hi!

We'd like to address the weekend's post-update bugs that kept some players unable to access the game, and some other players unable to access the Intrusion event.

First of all, thank you for your patience while we sorted that issue! We found the source of the problem and it isn't likely to happen again. For the most part, as this was our first Steam update of Booty Farm, we got cocky and launched it on a Friday. New platform - new things to look out for that we didn't know we had to look out for. A learning process!

We apologize to everyone who was affected by the bug. You can access your games (and events) properly now, no further updates required. Come Monday, we'll see what we can do about the lost event time. We'll let you know in the comments to this post (alternatively, you'll know once we add it to the game).

Thanks for sticking around as we fixed the update bugs! 
Tenderly,

[h2]PREMIUM GIRL: HOLLY THE BARISTA[/h2]

Hey studs, there's a new coffee shop in Booty Farm and MY, MY! The [b]barista [/b]is looking adorable. She's a little on the shy side, makes us wonder how she ever got into the service industry. Maybe someone has the hots for you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646508/70124ce7c397eb3da36f6ace2e773889e36b94b0.png[/img]

[i]Reach Booty Farm level 10 to unlock Holly.[/i]
